description: Defines the SimulatedTranscoder class used for testing media transcoding sessions in Android, including session management, event handling, and IPC testing.

classes.name: SimulatedTranscoder
classes.description: A class that simulates media transcoding sessions for testing IPC and session lifecycle events.

classes.name: SimulatedTranscoder::Event
classes.description: Represents various session events such as start, pause, resume, stop, finish, fail, and abandon.

methods.name: SimulatedTranscoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a callback interface.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a transcoding session with specified client and session IDs.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops a session, with optional abandonment.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts an Event::Type to its string representation.

methods.name: queueEvent
methods.description: Queues a session event for processing.

methods.name: threadLoop
methods.description: Main loop handling session event timing and execution.
